power_notes: VBUS_IN, VBUS and PVDD are budgeted at the real 5 A, the 28 V x 5 A PD contract (the firmware governor holds sustained input near 13 W, so 5 A is the peak), and every layer's pour carries it on its own (check_current): In1/In2 are 1 oz, and kicad/gen/power_trunk.py cleared the GND stitch grid from the In2 power planes and reshaped their zones after planes_gen (the In2 regions here are the rectangles planes_gen lays; that script's ZONES are the outlines on the board). Overrides at 3.0 A, VBUS at R1's output pad and PVDD at Q1's drain: there the F.Cu patches (review-2 POWER-1) only spread the pad's current into their 7-10 vias to the In2 plane, so a neck between via groups carries at most the share of the vias past it (4 of 7, 2.9 A). PVDD overrides at 2.5 A: each F.Cu finger between an amp's output pins feeds one bridge, so at full stereo drive on Plus (U15 only) a finger carries half the 5 A; the pin pitch fixes its 1.6-1.75 mm width, and its five vias into the In2 plane sit 1-4 mm from the pins. kicad/core.kicad_dru keeps its width rules: re-running rules_gen from these budgets would ask every plane tap for trunk width, as it reads no plane_fed. Track widths here are sized for the tracks that remain: plane taps and short stubs. The main currents ride on copper the width rules can't see: VBUS_IN/VBUS/PVDD/+3V3 on In2 plane regions plus F.Cu pours, and the amp OUT/SPK nets (3.7 A rms continuous sine, 2 x 56 W governor-capped) on the solid fan-in pours from kicad/gen/power_zones.py. check_irdrop covers those paths at P8. +5V is budgeted at 1.1 A, what the SY8303 delivers at the worst case of its loads: the SY8089 3V3 buck's input at the +3V3 budget of 0.8 A (ESP32 radio peaks; 3.3 x 0.8 / (0.88 x 5.0) = 0.60 A), LP5907 3V3A 0.10 A, +5VA 0.05 A, two TPA3221 VDD/GVDD/AVDD 0.10 A, the ultra-front board over J3 0.15 A and the CH340C 0.02 A (1.02 A). The trunk from L9 to U5's VIN is 0.58-0.60 mm, past the 0.56 mm that 1.1 A needs at dT=10, and BUCK5_LX carries the same 1.1 A. Every other +5V track is a branch off that trunk and sits in an override at 0.4 A: by a DC solve of the routed copper the most any branch carries is 0.29 A (amp A, CH340C and the front board, west), and the buck output caps' (C13/C14) and the 3V3 buck's input cap's (C15) ripple stays under 0.4 A rms; 0.35 mm tracks carry 0.7 A, so the branches have margin. No override circle reaches a trunk segment's midpoint. The firmware governor holds the sustained input to ~13 W (0.47 A) and bursts to the 1 s supply budget.
diff_pairs_note: Explicitly empty. The USB full-speed pair (12 Mb/s) and the two 100BASE-TX pairs run about 10 mm, so coupling them adds nothing measurable, and the router doesn't couple pairs (route_critical's KRT diff pass shorted). They are routed as ordinary nets at the Default width.

exempt_notes.speaker outputs (J6/J7/J10/J11): each leg's LC filter cap (1 uF X7R, plus the 470 nF Zobel) sits about 6 mm from the binding post, and the 10 uH inductor stands between it and the TPA3220 pin. An IEC 61000-4-2 8 kV contact strike carries 150 pF x 8 kV = 1.2 uC: about 0.8 V on 1.47 uF. The inductor blocks the ns edge from the amp. A TVS would add nothing (docs/boards/core-esd.md).
exempt_notes.Ethernet (J2): HR911105A is a MagJack: the cable side ends on the integrated transformers and Bob Smith termination (1500 Vrms isolation), so the strike never reaches these PHY-side pins directly. +3V3E is the centre-tap supply on the PHY side.
